scripts.dev: node api.js && bun run setup:dev && cd tauri && bun run tauri dev
scripts.dev:web: node api.js && cd web && bun run dev
scripts.dev:landing: node api.js && cd landing && bun run dev
scripts.build: node api.js && ./scripts/build-server.sh && cd tauri && bun run tauri build
scripts.build:web: node api.js && cd web && bun run build
scripts.build:landing: node api.js && cd landing && bun run build
scripts.generate:keys: cd tauri && bun tauri signer generate -w ~/.tauri/voicebox.key
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc -p app/tsconfig.json --noEmit && cd web && bunx tsc --noEmit
scripts.ci: bun run typecheck && bun run build:web
